findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization and pickle usage in snowflake.connector
 * @description Detects uses of pickle and other unsafe deserialization APIs in the snowflake.connector package.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/snowflake-connector/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/snowflake/connector/%") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation in snowflake.connector that could execute arbitrary code if used on untrusted data."
findings.hypothesis: Package uses pickle/yaml/marshal for deserialization, which could be unsafe on untrusted data.

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation in snowflake.connector that could execute arbitrary code if used on untrusted data.
